# Account & profile
{: .no_toc }

View and edit the signed-in user's global profile.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `ACC-01` |
| **Route** | `/account` · deep link `substratal://account` |
| **Where** | Personal › Account |
| **Who can use it** | Self |
| **Kind** | settings |
| **Available in** | All Hub apps (MVP) |
| **On Linux** | `AdwPreferencesPage` |

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Avatar | image-picker | Profile.avatar_url | camera / photo library / file / paste; client uploads to app asset storage then PATCHes URL* | GtkFileDialog (portal) |
| Display name | text-field | Profile.display_name | required; ≤ 100; save on blur/Return | AdwEntryRow |
| Email | row → ACC-02 | User.email + email_verified + pending_email | shows "Pending: {pending_email}" when set | AdwActionRow activatable |
| User ID | id-chip | User.id | copy | GtkLabel .monospace + copy |
| Contact email | email-field | Profile.contact_email | optional | AdwEntryRow input-purpose=email |
| Contact phone | phone-field | Profile.contact_phone | optional; E.164 formatting by locale | AdwEntryRow input-purpose=phone |
| Plan | row → BIL-01 | User.plan free\ | standard + plan_sources | AdwActionRow activatable |
| Member since / last sign-in | caption | User.created_at, last_login_at | locale formatted | GtkLabel .caption .dim-label |
| Sign out | button | POST /auth/logout | always visible at the bottom of Account (mobile) / account menu (desktop) | GtkButton |

## What happens when you act

| Action | API call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Edit field | `PATCH /users/me/profile (If-Match)` | Save per field; 409 version_conflict → reload prompt; 422 → field error. |
| Sign out | `POST /auth/logout` | best effort; always wipe local credentials and cache → AUTH-01 |

## Good to know

- **Loading, empty and error states:** Loading: skeleton after 300 ms; Error: inline with Retry; codes per COPY-AND-STATES
- *The API stores `avatar_url` only. Upload target is a client-side decision (spec gap — see OPEN-QUESTIONS).

## For developers

Loads: `GET /users/me` · `GET /users/me/profile`

Every call sends `Substratal-Version: 1` to `https://api.substratalapps.com` (no `/v1` in the path). See [API versioning]({{ '/api/versioning/' | relative_url }}) and the [API reference]({{ '/api/reference/' | relative_url }}).
